code_evidence.snippet:
def score_cover_topk(x: torch.Tensor, score: float):
    cumsum_x = torch.cumsum(torch.sort(x, dim=-1, descending=True).values, dim=-1)
    topk = torch.sum(cumsum_x <= score, dim=-1) + 1
    return topk
